canonical_project: Linlithgow Campus data centre (former Oracle facility)

location.country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

notes: Former Oracle/Sun Linlithgow data centre site; marketing brochure says Oracle previously operated the on-site data centre, a certificate of lawfulness covers data centre use, and existing supply is 6.8MW with 4MW available; The Register reported in 2021 that Oracle planned to close the facility, so current operating status is uncertain.
